sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Tank-and-spank with two split phases (66% and 33%) where three colored guardians spawn and must all die to bring Vale Guardian back.

sections.heading: Phase — Vale Guardian
bullets: Magic Storm: gives the boss a breakbar — break it to shut the attack down.
Green circle appears on the ground — get at least 4 players standing in it before it closes, or the group takes heavy damage.
Tank stays in melee range facing the boss away from the group; keep steady pressure between splits.

sections.heading: Split Phase (66% / 33%)
bullets: Vale Guardian goes invulnerable; Red, Green, and Blue guardians spawn on their own pillars.
Split into 3 groups, one per color, and aim to kill all three at roughly the same time.
Stay on your color's platform — stepping off deals heavy ongoing damage.
Red spawns adds, Green drops teleport circles, Blue applies a boon that needs to be stripped.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: No hard enrage — a slow group usually loses to a split-phase mistake before running out of time. Keep splits clean and fast.
